blockers.text: Pending vendor redlines on DPA regarding sub-processor notification window and data residency clause

key_quotes: Legal flagged two items in the DPA: sub-processor notification is 14 days and we asked for 30, and there's no explicit data residency clause.
If not, I'd rather delay a week than launch on an unreviewed DPA.
Can you let the exec team know the date is at risk?
summary: Anita addressed concerns regarding whether the vendor security review will delay the upcoming launch. Legal identified two DPA issues regarding sub-processor notification timelines and data residency clauses. Anita requested vendor redlines and asked Sofia to inform the executive team that the launch date is at risk.
title: Vendor security review — blocking launch?
